description: The town's eccentricities become increasingly reflective rather than merely strange: aging, faith, family, art, cultural identity and romance collide as Joel grows more embedded in Cicely while Maggie, Chris, Ed, Maurice, Holling and Shelly face their own transformations.

s04e01.description: Maggie's birthday sparks a crisis over aging and accumulated loss, leading her to a Native ritual intended to release the past rather than keep cataloguing it.

s04e02.description: Endless summer daylight supercharges Joel's libido and attracts an adventure salesman, while Shelly's old cheerleading uniform unexpectedly energizes Holling.

s04e03.description: Chris accidentally kills a dog and falls for its mathematician owner, while Maurice buys a magnificent clock whose perfection proves more complicated than expected.

s04e04.description: A visiting rock star becomes the subject of Ed's latest film and plans a Native collaboration, while Chris searches for the right way to honor a dead friend.

s04e05.description: Severely allergic Mike Monroe comes to Cicely seeking clean air inside a geodesic dome, while Ruth-Anne's polished, ambitious son visits and exposes family differences.

s04e06.description: The silent Flying Man returns with a mime troupe, while a ruby discovered inside a fish sends Ed into a romantic, cinematic fantasy about destiny.

s04e07.description: Holling meets an adult daughter he never knew existed and quickly decides she is a corrupting influence, while Ed forms an unlikely bond with a migrating crane.

s04e08.description: Cicely mixes Thanksgiving with a Day of the Dead celebration, forcing Joel to confront a holiday culture very different from his own as Chris revisits painful memories.

s04e09.description: A former KGB officer offers Maurice an embarrassing dossier, a zealous health inspector targets the Brick, and another death makes Maggie determined to live differently.

s04e10.description: Chris is arrested for an old parole violation, and his extradition hearing becomes a community argument over law, character and whether Cicely can claim him as its own.

s04e11.description: Maggie's yard becomes an archaeological battleground, Ed prepares for environmental catastrophe, and a runaway boy working at the Brick develops an intense crush on Shelly.

s04e12.description: Chris retreats to a monastery seeking spiritual clarity and encounters an unexpected attraction, while Ruth-Anne's final payment on her store irritates Maurice.

s04e13.description: Ed finally meets the man identified as his father, Maggie and Mike cross a romantic line, and an abrasive blind piano tuner disrupts the Brick.

s04e14.description: Maggie brings Joel home to pose as her boyfriend at her grandmother's birthday, exposing him to family tensions, old romances and an unexpectedly athletic rivalry.

s04e15.description: A rigid teacher makes Holling doubt his ability to earn a diploma and clashes with Maggie, while Joel frets helplessly over Marilyn's independent trip to Seattle.

s04e16.description: A powerful wind seems to loosen everyone's restraints, provoking Joel and Maggie into open conflict, Chris and Maurice into a bizarre encounter, and Ed into thoughts of death.

s04e17.description: Joel is furious when Maggie forgets their intimate night, Uncle Anku urges Ed toward marriage, and Holling joins Ruth-Anne for an unexpectedly revealing birdwatching trip.

s04e18.description: The winter solstice drives Chris toward a major art project and a denied vacation tempts Joel into unethical behavior, while Cicely rallies around a struggling veteran.

s04e19.description: A ceremonial totem-pole unveiling revives an old family feud, while Shelly tries marriage as a practical cure for increasingly vivid hallucinations.

s04e20.description: Mike announces he is leaving just as Maggie plans a romantic dinner, Maurice relocates his ancestral home to Alaska, and Shelly's redecorating overwhelms Holling.

s04e21.description: Maurice celebrates KBHR's anniversary with an exclusive party that draws Adam and Eve back to town and leaves an excluded Joel unusually wounded.

s04e22.description: Joel searches Cicely for enough Jewish men to say kaddish for his uncle, while Chris and Bernard inherit a West Virginia blood feud and Marilyn chooses Holling as a dance partner.

s04e23.description: Spring arrives with mosquitoes and a truffle-hunting pig, awakening Holling's urge to plant and revealing a startling healing ability in Maggie.

s04e24.description: Maurice's old wartime hatred resurfaces when Duk Won asks permission to marry, while Ed works to preserve the Tlingit language and Holling confronts an unusual thirst.

s04e25.description: Maurice wants Cicely's ancient tree cut down as Joel fights to save it, Shelly cannot stop singing, and Maggie's relentless kindness nearly drives Joel mad.
